SUMMARY.md: One entry per model, best first.

Open data files published by ArtificialWatch (artificialwatch.com, Mark Studios, LLC): two AI model leaderboard indexes (Bench Index, Coding Index), a launch lead-time table, and the Wire news feed as RSS. No key, no sign-up, CORS enabled, cached for an hour, rebuilt daily. Documented at https://artificialwatch.com/data; every schema was taken from live GET probes on 2026-10-23. The docs say a request that lands mid-rebuild gets HTTP 503 {"error":"the table is rebuilding"} (not observed). The keys of a model's scores map are the ids of that file's sources (six boards for the Bench Index, three for the Coding Index on the probe date); a board that does not rate the model has a null score. The CSV twin of each JSON file (same path with .csv) is not modelled. Licence: the composite index and percentiles are CC BY 4.0; raw scores belong to each board. Unverified: whether announced/`lead_minutes` can be null for an 'excluded' launch (the one excluded row had both).
When the sweep first found the model live on an API.
announced minus `first_seen` in minutes; positive means live before the announcement.
